rationale: Despite strong relative volume and a sharp reversal off the morning lows to test the 5-minute 9-EMA, the bid-ask spread is currently too wide at 53.9 bps ($0.13), which represents nearly 30% of a 5-minute ATR. Entering in either direction right at the 9-EMA inflection point with this level of friction severely degrades the immediate risk-to-reward profile.
